## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Select Default Commission Category › AC10/AC14: Flexi Rate 2.5% — single valid IC/RC auto-selects

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC10: Given a commission category and Flexi-Rate have been selected, When the user views the Select IC/RC field, Then only IC/RC options valid for the selected commission category and Flexi-Rate combination are displayed And invalid IC/RC options are not available for selection.
> AC14: Given the selected commission category and Flexi-Rate combination has only one valid IC/RC option, When the commission details are displayed, Then QA automatically selects the available IC/RC option And no manual user selection is required.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. Open a fresh priced quote (any valid persona).
> 2. Set Flexi Rate = 2.5% on the quote.
> 3. Open Adviser Use.
> 4. Read the Select IC/RC dropdown selected value.
> 
> Expected: Auto-selected to IC-100%, RC-50% (the only Upfront-valid option).
> Actual (current): Stays on "Please Select".

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC14: default IC/RC for Upfront, single valid option

expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality

Expected: "IC-100%, RC-50%"
```

### ❌ Select Default Commission Category — Save & Persistence › AC06/AC07/AC08: Update button save, confirmation message, persistence

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC06: Given the user has selected a different commission category, When the user clicks the Update button, Then the selected commission category is saved as the agency default And the updated value is available for future quotes and applications.
> AC07: Given the default commission category has been successfully saved, When the save operation completes, Then the following confirmation message is displayed: "Your default commission structure setting has been updated."
> AC08: Given a default commission category has been saved, When the user exits and later reopens the Adviser Use function, Then the previously saved default commission category is displayed.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. Open a fresh priced quote, open Adviser Use.
> 2. Confirm current default is Upfront.
> 3. Change Default for Agency to Level 30.
> 4. Click the Update button.
> 5. Check for the confirmation message.
> 6. Sign out completely.
> 7. Sign back in with the same account.
> 8. Open a new fresh priced quote, open Adviser Use.
> 9. Check whether the value persisted as Level 30.
> 
> Expected: Confirmation message appears (AC07); fresh session shows Level 30 (AC06/AC08).
> Actual (current): No confirmation message. Fresh session still shows Upfront — value did not persist.

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: Login failed: credentials rejected or session conflict.
```

![Select Default Commission Category — Save & Persistence › AC06/AC07/AC08: Update button save, confirmation message, persistence](data:image/png;base64,)

### ❌ Select Default Commission Category › AC10/AC15: Flexi Rate 12.5% — multiple valid IC/RC, no auto-select

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC10: Given a commission category and Flexi-Rate have been selected, When the user views the Select IC/RC field, Then only IC/RC options valid for the selected commission category and Flexi-Rate combination are displayed And invalid IC/RC options are not available for selection.
> AC15: Given the selected commission category and Flexi-Rate combination has more than one valid IC/RC option, When the user creates or updates a quote/application, Then QA does not automatically select an IC/RC option And the user must manually choose an available IC/RC option.

> 3. Open Adviser Use.
> 4. Read the Select IC/RC dropdown selected value.
